purpose: 2D soil-structure interaction analysis of a cut-and-cover underground structure with diaphragm walls and base slab on Winkler spring supports.
Description of Building Structural Syste: Underground H-frame cut-and-cover structure with reinforced concrete diaphragm walls and base slab, supported on compression-only Winkler springs representing surrounding soil.
Description of Model: 2D finite element model using dispBeamColumn elements for diaphragm walls (30 elements each) and base slab (9 elements), with ENT (Elastic No Tension) uniaxial materials for horizontal and vertical Winkler springs across 5 soil layers. Two load cases: uniform earth pressure (15 kPa) and hydrostatic water pressure (triangular distribution). Static analysis with gravity freeze then lateral load application using opst.anlys.SmartAnalyze.
Notes: ST31 (L2) underground structure model with two selectable lateral load cases: case 1 = uniform earth pressure (15 kPa), case 2 = hydrostatic water pressure (triangular). Model uses --case argument to switch.

purpose: Quasi-static cyclic pushover of a 3D non-ductile RC frame representative of Italian pre-1970s construction (gravity-only design).
Description of Building Structural Syste: Model of a 2/3 scale RC frame designed for gravity loads only and tested by Calvi et al. (2003). Reinforced concrete frames typical of Italy (1950s–1970s), designed for gravity loads only. Masonry infill provides additional stiffness and strength. Uses smooth bars with insufficient detailing and anchorage.
Description of Model: 3D finite element model of a 3-story, 3-bay moment-resisting frame with fiber-section forceBeamColumn elements, zero-length joint rotational springs (Pinching4), and lumped plasticity hinges. Quasi-static cyclic pushover using opst.anlys.SmartAnalyze with displacement-controlled loading. ODB-based response collection via opst.post.CreateODB.
Suggested Model citation: O'Reilly, G. J., Sullivan, T. J. (2019). Modeling Techniques for the Seismic Assessment of Existing Italian RC Frame Structures, Journal of Earthquake Engineering, 23(8), pp.1262–1296. DOI: 10.1080/13632469.2017.1360224.
Links to Papers / Design Reports: Calvi, G. M., Magenes, G., Pampanin, S. (2002). Experimental Test on a Three Storey RC Frame Designed for Gravity Only, 12th European Conference on Earthquake Engineering, London.
Notes: Port of the Tcl model by Gerard J. O'Reilly (github.com/gerardjoreilly/Numerical-Modelling-of-GLD-RC-Frames). Non-ductile detailing typical of Italian pre-1970s construction with smooth bars and end-hooks.

purpose: 2D soil-structure interaction analysis of a cut-and-cover underground box-with_leg-frame structure with diaphragm walls and base/top slabs on Winkler spring supports.
Description of Building Structural Syste: Underground Box-with_leg-frame cut-and-cover structure with reinforced concrete diaphragm walls, a top slab, and a base slab, supported on compression-only Winkler springs representing surrounding soil.
Description of Model: 2D finite element model using dispBeamColumn elements for diaphragm walls (32 elements each), top slab (9 elements), and base slab (9 elements), with ENT (Elastic No Tension) uniaxial materials for horizontal and vertical Winkler springs across 5 soil layers. Two load cases: uniform earth pressure (15 kPa) and hydrostatic water pressure (triangular distribution). Static analysis with gravity freeze then lateral load application using opst.anlys.SmartAnalyze.
Notes: ST31 (L1) underground box-with_leg-frame model with two selectable lateral load cases: case 1 = uniform earth pressure (15 kPa), case 2 = hydrostatic water pressure (triangular). Model uses --case argument to switch.

purpose: Nonlinear dynamic earthquake and pushover analysis of a 4-story 3-bay steel special moment frame (SMF) with panel zones and IMK springs to study seismic collapse capacity.
Description of Building Structural Syste: 4-story, 3-bay steel special moment-resisting frame (SMF) per AISC 341 seismic provisions with W14 columns (W14x68 upper stories, W14x132 lower stories) and W21 beams with Reduced Beam Section (RBS) connections. An elastic gravity frame (EGF) leaning column captures P-Delta effects from tributary gravity loads. Column splices located at mid-height of stories 3-4.
Description of Model: 2D finite element model with 16 panel zones (ConstructPanel_Rectangle parallelogram model), Skiadopoulos-Elkady-Lignos Hysteretic panel zone springs (Spring_PZ), and IMKBilin rotational springs (Spring_IMK) at all beam and column ends calibrated with Lignos-Krawinkler (2011) and Lignos et al. (2019) regression equations. Column elastics use ModElasticBeam2d with stiffness modifier n=10. Gravity uses SmartAnalyze (load-controlled static); dynamic uses DynamicAnalysisCollapseSolverX with Newmark integration, Rayleigh damping zeta=2% applied to modes 1 and 3. ODB response collection via opst.post.CreateODB.
Lateral system: Special Moment-Resisting Frame (SMF) with RBS connections and panel zones
Suggested Model citation: Elkady, A. and Lignos, D.G. (2014). Modeling of the Composite Action in Fully Restrained Beam-to-Column Connections: Implications in the Seismic Design and Collapse Capacity of Steel Special Moment Frames. Earthquake Engineering & Structural Dynamics 43(13).
Links to Papers / Design Reports: Lignos, D.G. and Krawinkler, H. (2011). Deterioration Modeling of Steel Components in Support of Collapse Prediction of Steel Moment Frames under Earthquake Loading. Journal of Structural Engineering 137(11). Lignos, D.G. et al. (2019). Proposed Updates to the ASCE 41 Nonlinear Modeling Parameters for Wide-Flange Steel Columns. Journal of Structural Engineering 145(9). Skiadopoulos, A., Elkady, A. and Lignos, D.G. (2020). Proposed Panel Zone Model for Seismic Design of Steel MRFs. ASCE Journal of Structural Engineering.
Notes: Converted from original Tcl script (SMF4B.tcl) by Dr. Ahmed Elkady. All units converted from imperial (ksi, inches, kips) to N-mm-MPa. Model folder contains all Python helper modules (spring_imk, spring_pz, constructpanel_rectangle, etc.) and ground motion file NR94cnp.txt.

purpose: Nonlinear dynamic time-history analysis of a 6-story 5-bay steel concentrically-braced frame with rocking, PT strands, and fuse assemblies for seismic collapse assessment.
Description of Building Structural Syste: 6-story, 5-bay by 5-bay steel concentrically-braced frame with rocking connections consisting of pinned column bases, PT (post-tensioning) strands, and replaceable fuse assemblies. The rocking mechanism allows controlled uplift under seismic loading, with self-centering capability provided by PT strands and energy dissipation through steel fuse elements.
Description of Model: 3D finite element model using elasticBeamColumn elements for beams, columns, and braces with 12 section definitions. Rocking connections modeled with ENT base springs and twoNodeLink elements. PT strands as truss elements with ElasticPP material. Fuse assemblies use SelfCentering (gap) and Steel01 uniaxial materials in zeroLength elements. Rayleigh damping applied to modes 1 and 3. Gravity: manual LoadControl loop with Linear algorithm (SmartAnalyze Static incompatible — forces DisplacementControl). Dynamic: SmartAnalyze Transient with Newmark integration and UniformExcitation ground motion input. ODB response collection via opst.post.CreateODB with selective element tags and throttled fetch (every 10th step) for performance.
Lateral system: Concentrically-Braced Frame (CBF) with rocking, PT strands, and fuses
Links to Papers / Design Reports: Homorzabad, S. (2021). CRSBF-NDAP.py — optimization framework for concentrically-braced frames with rocking.
Notes: Converted from original CRSBF-NDAP.py script by S. Homorzabad. All units converted to N-mm-MPa. Ground motion file stored in ground_motions/ subfolder. LESSONS LEARNED: (1) SmartAnalyze Static forces DisplacementControl — LoadControl gravity must use manual ops.analyze() loop (exception documented in AGENT.md v1.6.0 §3c/§10). (2) ODB fetch_response_step() throttled to every 10th step with selective element tags to avoid hang on 2500-step transient analysis (guidance in AGENT.md §3d).

purpose: Nonlinear gravity + eigen analysis of a 5-storey infilled RC frame (Archetype 1, GLD) with masonry infill struts for seismic assessment of existing Italian construction.
Description of Building Structural Syste: 5-storey, 8x4-bay 3D RC moment-resisting frame designed for gravity loads only (GLD), typical of Italian pre-1970s construction. Masonry infill walls provide additional stiffness via equivalent diagonal struts. Smooth bars with end-hooks, non-ductile detailing. Columns: 300x300mm (stories 1-2) and 200x200mm (stories 3-5). Beams: 500x300mm throughout.
Description of Model: 3D finite element model with lumped-plasticity forceBeamColumn elements (Pinching4 hinges), zero-length joint rotational springs (Hysteretic material), and masonry infill struts (single diagonal, Pinching4 material). Grid: 8 columns x 4 rows, bay widths 3.5-20.0m X, 3.0-9.0m Y. Four infill failure modes: compression centre, compression corner, shear sliding, diagonal tension. Drift limits from Sassun et al. (2015). Gravity: manual LoadControl loop (SmartAnalyze Static incompatible). Eigen: ops.eigen(). Response collection via opst.post.CreateODB (Zarr/ODB-based for opstool >= 1.0).
Lateral Loading: Gravity + eigen only (dynamic hook for future Master script)
Suggested Model citation: Nafeh, A. M. B. (2020). Infilled-RC-Building-Database. IUSS Pavia. Hak et al. (2012). Sassun et al. (2015).
Links to Papers / Design Reports: Nafeh, A. M. B. (2020). Seismic Assessment of Infilled RC Frame Buildings. PhD Thesis, IUSS Pavia. O'Reilly, G. J., Sullivan, T. J. (2019) J. Earthquake Eng., 23(8), 1262-1296.
Notes: Port of arch_1_5st.tcl from Infilled-RC-Building-Database. All Tcl reference files preserved in tcl_reference/. Units: N-mm-MPa-tonne. Uses opstool >= 1.0 post.CreateODB API (Zarr/ODB backend). Helper modules (joint_model.py, rc_bc_non_duct.py, infill.py) are model-local ports from Tcl procedures. Gravity per AGENT.md §3c exception (manual LoadControl loop). Run with: conda activate opensy && python model.py.

purpose: Static pushover analysis of a single-bay single-story 3D steel moment-resisting frame with Modified Ibarra-Krawinkler (Bilin) concentrated plastic hinges for collapse assessment.
Description of Building Structural Syste: Single-bay, single-story steel moment-resisting frame with W10X33 beams and box-section columns (b=8.02 in, t=0.35 in). The frame is a simplified test case from the WoodFrameBuildingTool suite developed by Xiaolei Xiong (Tongji University) based on the original modelling framework by Henry Burton (Stanford University).
Description of Model: 3D finite element model (ndm=3, ndf=6) using elasticBeamColumn elements for beams and columns with zero-length concentrated rotational springs at all member ends. Plastic hinges use the Bilin uniaxial material (Modified Ibarra-Krawinkler deterioration model) with parameters calibrated from Lignos & Krawinkler (2011) empirical regression equations for steel W-sections. Rigid diaphragm constraint at roof level via equalDOF. Gravity: manual LoadControl loop (SmartAnalyze Static incompatible — see AGENT.md §3c exception). Pushover: SmartAnalyze Static with DisplacementControl to 10% drift. Response collection via opst.post.CreateODB (Zarr/ODB backend). Original Tcl reference files preserved in ref/ subdirectory.
Suggested Model citation: Xiong, X., and Burton, H. (2017). WoodFrameBuildingTool — A parametric OpenSees modelling framework for wood and steel moment-resisting frames. Tongji University / Stanford University.
Links to Papers / Design Reports: Ibarra, L. F., and Krawinkler, H. (2005). Global collapse of frame structures under seismic excitations. Technical Report 152, Stanford. Lignos, D. G., and Krawinkler, H. (2011). Deterioration Modeling of Steel Components in Support of Collapse Prediction of Steel Moment Frames under Earthquake Loading. ASCE Journal of Structural Engineering, 137(11), pp. 1291-1302.
Notes: Converted from original Tcl scripts in Xiaolei MomentFrame/ directory. Single-bay single-story simplified test case (NStory=0, NBase=1, XBay=1, ZBay=1). Original unit system: kips, inches, seconds — all values converted to N, mm, MPa. Reference Tcl files, Database.csv, and supporting files preserved in ref/ directory. Gravity uses manual LoadControl loop per AGENT.md §3c exception. Run with: conda activate opensy && python model.py.
